# Dawnexus — Full Documentation & Information Architecture

> Dawnexus is a modern digital engineering and performance marketing agency based in Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu, India.

## About Dawnexus
Dawnexus helps ambitious businesses scale through custom full-stack web application development, technical search engine optimization (SEO), automated AI video creative pipelines, and performance digital advertising.

- **Website**: https://www.dawnexus.in
- **Headquarters**: Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu, India
- **Email**: contact@dawnexus.in
- **Primary Domain**: Technology & Performance Marketing

## Core Services

### 1. Website Design & Development
- **URL**: https://www.dawnexus.in/services/website-design
- **Capabilities**: Custom React/Vite/Next.js development, responsive UI/UX architecture, headless CMS integration, sub-second TTFB, sub-2.5s LCP, Core Web Vitals optimization, and conversion-centered design.

### 2. Search Engine Optimization (SEO)
- **URL**: https://www.dawnexus.in/services/seo-services
- **Capabilities**: Full technical SEO audits, Schema.org JSON-LD structured data engineering, crawl budget and internal linking optimization, local Google Business Profile optimization, and long-tail search intent capture.

### 3. AI Video Creation & Marketing
- **URL**: https://www.dawnexus.in/services/ai-video-creation
- **Capabilities**: Generative commercial video pipelines, automated product showcase reels, multilingual voiceovers, visual storytelling, and high-CTR social media ad creatives.

### 4. Performance Digital Marketing
- **URL**: https://www.dawnexus.in/services/digital-marketing
- **Capabilities**: High-ROI paid traffic campaigns across Google Ads, Meta Ads, and LinkedIn, conversion rate optimization (CRO), custom lead capture funnels, and real-time attribution tracking.

## Interactive Tools
- **Website Cost Calculator**: https://www.dawnexus.in/website-cost-calculator
  An interactive, transparent project cost estimation tool providing line-item calculations for web application scope, page counts, backend feature complexity, and custom design tiers in Indian Rupees (₹).
